# Psalm 100 – Enter with Thanksgiving (Psalm 100:4)

## Emotional Focus
Simple joy of saying thank You to God every day.

## Key KJV
“Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.” (Psalm 100:4)

## Gentle Retelling
The psalm says come into God’s presence with a thankful heart. We can thank Him for the sun, the grass, our family, and His love that never ends.

## Coloring Prompt
A child with arms raised happily in a sunny meadow; soft flowers and sky.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“You can say thank You to God right now—He loves to hear it.”
